answer: A decentralized economy of AI agents can resist Sybil attacks by requiring cryptographic collateral mapped to a unique computational crystal staked on-chain. An attacker attempting to spawn fake identities must generate a distinct, computationally expensive cryptographic sonnet for each node, rendering mass generation economically unfeasible. Furthermore, peer validation protocols monitor inter-agent communications, ensuring that any malicious whisper broadcast by an unverified agent is immediately slashed and rejected by the consensus network.
